public..read:
auth != null &&
                 auth.token.trackingId === $trackingId &&
                 (
                   auth.token.supervisor === true ||
                   (
                     auth.token.role === 'agent' &&
                     ('stage_' + auth.token.stage) === $stageId
                   )
                 )

private..read:
auth != null &&
                 auth.token.trackingId === $trackingId &&
                 (
                   auth.token.supervisor === true ||
                   (
                     auth.token.role === 'agent' &&
                     ('stage_' + auth.token.stage) === $stageId
                   )
                 )
